req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. We need: (1) a positive case confirming a valid string title returns 201, (2) negative cases for each non-string type (integer, boolean, null, array, object) returning exactly 422, and (3) a boundary case at the edge of valid/invalid type coercion. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (422 vs 201), exact response structure fields, and testing both sides of the type-validation branch. The positive case kills mutations that always return 422; the negative cases kill mutations that skip type validation or return wrong codes.

preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient

actions: POST /tasks/ with title as a valid non-empty string
expected: title in response equals the submitted string
trace: R-TASK-003: positive path — string title accepted, confirms 422 branch is not always taken
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r_task_003_pos.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Valid string title", "description": None, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid string title"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201()
